stem: Voltmarkt's CFO asks about Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices: "How many months of gross profit from the businesses we win does it take to earn back our sales and marketing spend?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: ARPA × gross margin / monthly logo churn rate
Sales and marketing cost / (new-business MRR × gross margin)
Sales and marketing cost / number of new businesses won in the month
100 × a cohort's MRR now / its MRR a year ago
